events.verdict: Christie (DAL) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact that occurs during Sharpe's (POR) driving shot attempt.
Washington (DAL) is already in Camara's (POR) path when contact occurs, and he absorbs the contact during the pick.
Camara (POR) moves alongside Washington's (DAL) path and marginal body contact occurs during the driving shot attempt.

Flagg (DAL) closes out and makes marginal contact with Grant's (POR) forearm on the follow through while contesting the shot attempt. Additional, he contest to the side and avoids making any torso or lower body contact with Grant.
Grant (POR) briefly places his arm around Williams' (DAL) body while defending the screen along the baseline.
Washington (DAL) brings his hands towards Sharpe (POR) as he releases away, and the contact during the pick is marginal.
Thompson (DAL) initiates contact with Sharpe's (POR) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt. Replay Review of the goaltending called on Flagg (DAL) was overturned to a legal block.
Camara (POR) initiates contact with Flagg's (DAL) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Avdija (POR) is bracing for the contact from Williams (DAL) as they come together at the end of the drive, and the contact that occurs as Avdija (POR) releases away is marginal.
Marshall (DAL) establishes a screening position outside of Camara's (POR) field of view and gives him a step to avoid the contact.
Sharpe (POR) moves alongside Flagg's (DAL) path and marginal body contact occurs during the high post shot attempt.
Marshall (DAL) legally contests Avdija's (POR) jump shot attempt.
Avdija (POR) contests the post shot attempt and marginal body contact occurs with Flagg (DAL) after the release.
Avdija (POR) grabs Gafford's (DAL) arm that affects his FOM off-ball in the post.
Washington (DAL) legally contests Sharpe's (POR) jump shot attempt.
Gafford (DAL) establishes, and maintains, a legal guarding position as he defends Grant (POR) and cleanly deflects the ball after the defensive switch.
Gafford (DAL) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact that occurs during Sharpe's (POR) layup attempt.
Clingan (POR) defends Gafford's (DAL) shot attempt arm and marginal contact occurs to his arm.
After Grant's gather, Gafford (DAL) reaches in and initiates contact with Grant's (POR) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Flagg (DAL) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds. Portland should have retrained the ball after the missed free throw.
Sharpe (POR) initiates contact with Williams' (DAL) body, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Christie (DAL) legally contests Grant's (POR) jump shot attempt.

Dallas secures possession of the ball with 22.8 seconds remaining and call a timeout with 16.5 seconds remaining on the previous possession. Therefore, accounting for time elapsed in the backcourt on the previous possession, Dallas does not advance the ball into the frontcourt within eight seconds
Williams (DAL) directly contests Love's (POR) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Love's (POR) hand after the release.
Murray (POR) commits a take foul on Marshall (DAL).
Murray (POR) is already in Marshall's (DAL) path when contact occurs, and he absorbs the contact during the screen.
Sharpe (POR) commits a take foul on Christie (DAL).
